name: UI：店铺信息配置-参考竞店sellerid自动带入名称验证
description: 添加参考竞店后输入sellerid，验证名称自动带入且名称字段disabled

steps.expression: (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(el => el.textContent.trim() === '编辑'); if(btns.length > 0) { btns[0].click(); return 'clicked'; } return 'no btn'; })()

(() => { const addBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('span,a,button')).find(el => el.textContent.trim() === '添加' && el.closest('main')); if(addBtn) { addBtn.click(); return 'added'; } return 'no add btn'; })()

(() => { const sidInput = document.querySelector('input[placeholder="请输入 sellerid"]'); if(!sidInput) return {error: 'no sellerid input'}; const nativeSetter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; nativeSetter.call(sidInput, '2219662018344'); sidInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); sidInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles:true})); return {filled: true}; })()

(() => { const nameInput = document.querySelector('input[placeholder="输入 sellerid 后自动带入"]'); return { autoFilledName: nameInput?.value || '', nameDisabled: nameInput?.disabled, nameHasValue: !!(nameInput?.value) }; })()

steps.description: 名称字段自动disabled不可编辑

_testDesign.realDomNotes: 实测: 输入sellerid '2219662018344' → 名称自动带入'F88测试店铺'，名称input自动disabled
